background: Deutsche Bank is Germany's largest bank, a universal bank with a large investment bank, a corporate bank, German retail banking under the Deutsche and Postbank brands, and the DWS asset manager.
synthesis: Ratings are A+ on average across all three main agencies, the weakest of them at A, two on a positive outlook and one on a stable outlook, with the last move a two-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026. The ratios are on the weak side of EU and Nordic banks: CET1 of 13.9%, leverage of 4.5% and LCR of 140% are all in the bottom quarter, and NSFR of 118% is below the peer median. None of the ratios has moved materially over the past four periods to 30 Jun 2026. The newest flagged item, on 8 Sep 2026, bundles industry lobbying with a legal settlement, and the others are settlements with former staff, none of them a credit event.
